user_review.method: Maintainer public-entry assessment and explicitly simulated instruction walkthroughs; not independent agent execution, human research or real customer results. Executed regex fixture is identified separately.

scenarios.request: No profile: check draft Quick one: meet [INSERT NAME].
scenarios.expected: Generic check only; exact placeholder span; no personal similarity score.
scenarios.observed: Maintainer walkthrough returns no-fingerprint, one placeholder violation [16,29), six of seven generic rules pass; drift n/a. Generic pass is not personal-voice validation.

scenarios.request: 40-token draft, 100-token MATTR profile, no reference corpus or aggregate formula.
scenarios.expected: Skip unavailable comparisons rather than score imagined values.
scenarios.observed: Before required an aggregate and claimed 40-word MATTR comparability. After MATTR null, Delta skipped, aggregate n/a; existing explicit rules still apply. Recovery is compatible baseline/text, not shrinking just one window.

scenarios.request: Five user-authored short samples; user explicitly accepts low confidence and confirms profile; dates unknown.
scenarios.expected: Partial profile with provenance and unknown dates; do not infer AI origin from punctuation.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough records known sample counts, leaves unknown ages and unsupported metrics null, confirms available voice preferences; no actual user profile written. Four samples instead requests a fifth. Conflicting registers prompt a targeted choice.

scenarios.request: Check documented placeholder regex with bracket, mixed-case brace, angle and clean-name fixtures.
scenarios.expected: Correct match spans including Company Name; clean control has no match.
scenarios.observed: Executed task fixture checker extracted the actual regex from SKILL.md; four checks passed. Does not validate a full host-agent extraction or enforcement run.

scenarios.request: Enforce with a partial profile and then with no profile.
scenarios.expected: Apply only measured/confirmed fields; missing profile cannot silently enforce.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough omits null template constraints and discloses skipped rules; missing-profile branch stops enforcement and requests extraction. User-approved profiles are not overwritten.

similar_skills.learned: Require real claims and lived product details; do not invent results when a voice guide is missing.
similar_skills.reason: Put evidence boundary at the prompt translation step and give a generic no-proof example; keep existing nonblocking generic mode instead of importing a mandatory interview.

similar_skills.learned: Separate user/audience context from a sample-derived voice profile; source samples before drafting.
similar_skills.reason: Retain sample-based extraction and personal-vs-company distinction. Reject automatic interviews on load, fixed tool dependence and assumed file authority; no external code copied.

validation.observed: Executed page and product metadata audit returned VERDICT: PASS.
Actual documented regex: bracket, mixed-case brace, angle and no-placeholder control passed; fixture offsets verified. Not a bundled statistical engine or end-to-end model test.

decision: Changed: compatible measurement provenance, missing-data and short-text rules, no inference of AI authorship from style, no unsupported aggregate score, reproducible example, mixed-case placeholder fix and canonical links. This remains an instruction package; statistical calibration and full agent execution are unverified.
